sponsor: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group (Sino Biopharmaceutical)
mechanism: inhaled dry-powder small molecule for COPD; target not disclosed in sources found
latest_data: Phase I SAD/MAD study of TQC3927 inhalation powder in COPD patients (n=48) completed Aug 2025 (NCT06711991); a multicenter randomized open-label Phase II dose-ranging study in COPD is listed (Synapse). No efficacy data disclosed publicly.
notes: Sponsor confirmed as Chia Tai Tianqing (CTTQ) on ClinicalTrials.gov via web search. Sister program TQC3721 is CTTQ's inhaled PDE3/4 inhibitor; TQC3927 target not confirmed.

mechanism: adipose-targeted THR-beta selective agonist (UCP-1-mediated thermogenesis), long-acting subcutaneous, once-monthly; muscle-preserving weight loss
indications: obesity (monotherapy and in combination with semaglutide)
latest_data: Phase Ib (Australia, 2025): single SC 90 mg in obese subjects gave placebo-adjusted weight loss peaking at 1.7% on day 50; t1/2 ~21 days supports monthly dosing; well tolerated up to 90 mg with no SAEs. ECO 2026: ASC47 + semaglutide showed 111.8% greater weight loss than semaglutide alone (Phase I). US FDA cleared IND for ASC47 + semaglutide combination (Mar 2025).
first_in_class_note: Positioned by Ascletis as first-in-class muscle-preserving, adipose-targeted THR-beta agonist for obesity
notes: Sponsor confirmed via web search. Ascletis (HKEX: 1672) runs its own trials in Australia and the US; no ex-China licensing found.
